verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical and both are broken. The hero photo of the woman has shrunk to a small thumbnail stuck in the bottom-left corner, which leaves a large empty white area at the bottom right. The six checkmarks don't line up with the list, which has been merged into three lines ('Chin Upper lip Ears'). The tape strips at the top float away from the card. B is slightly worse because its larger, darker tape covers more of the woman in the thumbnail.
